Arthur.day_scenario: Arthur rises at 6:00 AM to carefully water and weed the vegetable beds before the sun crests the fence, then settles into his armchair to read the Thursday newspaper. He spends the afternoon methodically tightening loose screws on the dining room chair and aligning his tools before retiring at 10:00 PM.

Martha.day_scenario: Martha steps onto the porch at 6:30 AM with a warm cup of tea, contentedly watching the cardinals visit the feeder. She spends her afternoon sorting lentils and rice into uniform canisters in the pantry, her knitting basket resting neatly on the craft table, and winds down for bed at 9:30 PM.
